gate.note: LEAD-RUN gate, 3 SEPARATE gate-case.mjs invocations (--n 1 each), origin/automation/base merged before each. NOTE: the lead's FIRST gate attempt (pre-stabilize) was RED — test_notification_link_navigates_to_bucket.py failed in the full-set run (1 failed/34 passed) while passing standalone (28.53s). The workflow's own internal gate had reported 3/3 green and did NOT surface it. Routed to batch-stabilize (run wf_2c544086-9df): root cause was a timing budget, NOT the lead's initial data-selection hypothesis — project 399 holds 1,049 artifact buckets, its list read measures 10-18s, and Artifacts.jsx renders the EMPTY state for the whole in-flight window, so a slow load was indistinguishable from a missing bucket against a flat 20s budget. Fixed with a context-level expect_event response gate on the popup's own bucket-LIST read (registered before the click, resolved before the row assertion) + budget raise, pinned by 16 new regression tests. No assertion added, weakened or removed; no sleep, skip or xfail.
